items.question: What is the notice period range under Article 43 of the UAE Labour Law for terminating an employment contract for any legitimate reason?
items.gold: The notice period must be not less than 30 days and not exceed 90 days.
items.fact: Article 43 notice period: minimum 30 days, maximum 90 days.

items.question: Within how many working days must an employer inform MoHRE of a worker's misconduct before terminating that worker without notice under the UAE Labour Law?
items.gold: The employer must inform MoHRE within seven working days from having knowledge of the incident.
items.fact: Employer must notify MoHRE within seven working days of misconduct.
